paper_metadata.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Portfolio Optimization Leveraging Counterdiabatic Annealing and Quantum Risk Factors

experiments.description: Hybrid quantum-classical portfolio optimization on a 10-asset real-market universe using a QUBO with classical mean-variance terms, an added quantum risk matrix from two-qubit Qiskit simulations, and D-Wave Advantage annealing with standard schedules; counterdiabatic effects were evaluated only in simulation/emulation.

algorithm.variant: Hybrid quantum-classical portfolio optimization with quantum-risk-augmented QUBO and counterdiabatic annealing analysis
algorithm.convergence_criteria: until stopping criteria / convergence or max iterations

hyperparameters.penalty_alpha: swept over logarithmic grids; examples reported: 100, 50, 10
hyperparameters.penalty_lambda: swept over logarithmic grids; examples reported: 10, 5, 0
hyperparameters.chain_strength: 1.0 to 2.0 depending on instance complexity; example 1.5

algorithm.parameter_initialization: Classical portfolio initialized randomly feasible; Qiskit entanglement circuit parameters sampled uniformly in [0, π]

problem_formulation.encoding_details: One binary inclusion variable per asset; portfolio size constraint enforced by quadratic penalty; quantum risk matrix added as pairwise quadratic term
problem_formulation.objective_function: maximize μ^T x - q x^T Σ x subject to 1^T x = B; equivalently minimize x^T Q_MV x + λ x^T E x + α(B - 1^T x)^2 with Q_MV = qΣ - 1/2 diag(μ)
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Quadratic penalty term α(B - 1^T x)^2; infeasible quantum samples repaired post hoc to satisfy 1^T x = B

problem_instance.description: Portfolio optimization over 10 S&P 100 equities with in-sample calibration and out-of-sample validation

preprocessing: daily log returns computed as log(p_t/p_{t-1})
annualized mean returns by multiplying by 252 trading days

noise_model.error_mitigation_method: majority vote chain-break resolution; no explicit noise model reported

implementation_details.classical_solver: SLSQP for classical optimization; Gurobi for MIQP baseline
classical_preprocessing: construct quantum risk matrix E from pairwise two-qubit Qiskit simulations
truncate E entries below epsilon to epsilon for robust penalty tuning
classical_postprocessing: repair infeasible quantum samples to satisfy cardinality
select best candidate among hybrid portfolios
compute out-of-sample Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown, volatility, and objective values
implementation_details.quantum_execution_time: approximately 0.1 seconds total anneal time per run (5000 reads × 20 µs)

convergence_data.variance_across_runs: 10 independent runs per (α, λ) configuration; mean and standard deviation reported

speedup_claims.factor: counterdiabatic term reduces diabatic error as O(1/T^2) plus O(1/K^2) dependence
speedup_claims.conditions: under smooth bounded Hamiltonians with a positive spectral gap and bounded commutator norms
speedup_claims.caveats: CD schedules were simulated/emulated on classical hardware; physical D-Wave runs used standard annealing schedules, so the claimed CD benefit was not physically demonstrated on the QPU.

speedup_claims.factor: approximately 5 seconds total runtime per portfolio instance; about 0.1 seconds of anneal time
speedup_claims.conditions: for n = 10 assets with 5000 reads and 20 microsecond anneals
speedup_claims.caveats: This is a runtime breakdown, not a direct speedup ratio; classical optimizer time was reported as 0.1–0.5 seconds per iteration over 10–20 iterations.

complexity_analysis.quantum_complexity: D-Wave annealing requires approximately n logical qubits plus embedding overhead; per-sample annealing time around 10–100 µs
complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: Classical optimizer reported as O(k n^3)
complexity_analysis.wall_clock_quantum: approximately 5 seconds total instance runtime including embedding, annealing, and evaluation; anneal time itself about 0.1 seconds
complexity_analysis.wall_clock_classical: 0.1–0.5 seconds per SLSQP iteration, typically 10–20 iterations

experiments.description: Quantum risk factor construction experiment using a two-qubit Qiskit Aer statevector simulator to compute entanglement-based pairwise risk terms for the portfolio QUBO.

algorithm.variant: Two-qubit entanglement proxy simulation for quantum risk matrix construction
algorithm.parameter_initialization: Random θ parameters sampled uniformly in [0, π]

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Two qubits per asset pair; parameterized Ry rotations followed by a CZ gate; von Neumann entropy of reduced density matrices used as entanglement proxy
problem_formulation.objective_function: Construct E_ij = |C_ij| + γ(S(ρ_i) + S(ρ_j) - S(ρ_ij)) and normalize by max entry

problem_instance.description: Pairwise quantum risk matrix generation for the 10-asset portfolio

preprocessing: classical correlation matrix C computed from annualized log returns
pairwise two-qubit simulation for each asset pair
von Neumann entropy computed from reduced density matrices
E symmetrized and normalized by maximum entry
small entries truncated to epsilon = 1e-4 in robustness analysis

classical_preprocessing: assemble and normalize quantum risk matrix E
classical_postprocessing: optionally truncate small entries to epsilon
